lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੀ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai bahu bidh pekhio doojaa naahee ree kooo ||
lines.translation: I have looked in so many ways, but there is no other like the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਊ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d deep sabh bheetar raviaa poor rahio sabh looo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: On all the continents and islands, He is permeating and fully pervading; He is in all worlds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੰਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਮਹਿੰਮਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam aga(n)maa kavan mahi(n)maa man jeevai sun sooo ||
lines.translation: He is the most unfathomable of the unfathomable; who can chant His Praises? My mind lives by hearing news of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸਰਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰੰਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਤੋਊ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaar aasaram chaar bara(n)naa mukat bhae sevatooo ||1||
lines.translation: People in the four stages of life, and in the four social classes are liberated, by serving You, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabad driRaaiaa param pad paaiaa dutee gae sukh hooo ||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted the Word of His Shabad within me; I have attained the supreme status. My sense of duality has been dispelled, and now, I am at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਹਜੋਊ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tariaa har nidh paaee sahajooo ||2||2||33||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have easily crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, obtaining the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||2||2||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai re har ekai jaan ||
lines.translation: Know that there is One and only One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai re guramukh jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Gurmukh, know that He is One. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਉ ਤੁਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe bhramat hau tum bhramahu na bhaaee raviaa re raviaa srab thaan ||1||
lines.translation: Why are you wandering around? O Siblings of Destiny, don't wander around; He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕਾਸਟ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar kaasat majhaar bin sa(n)jam nahee kaaraj saar ||
lines.translation: As the fire in the forest, without control, cannot serve any purpose

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur na paavaigo har jee ko duaar ||
lines.translation: just so, without the Guru, one cannot attain the Gate of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)gat taj abhimaan kahu naanak paae hai param nidhaan ||2||1||34||
lines.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, renounce your ego; says Nanak, in this way, the supreme treasure is obtained. ||2||1||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanee na jaaee taa kee gaat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His state cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਪੇਖਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮੇ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kah pekhaarau hau kar chaturaaee bisaman bisame kahan kahaat ||1||
lines.translation: How can I behold Him through clever tricks? Those who tell this story are wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਿਧ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: gan ga(n)dharab sidh ar saadhik ||
lines.translation: The servants of God, the celestial singers, the Siddhas and the seekers,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar dev braham brahamaadik ||
lines.translation: the angelic and divine beings, Brahma and those like Brahma,

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chatur bed ucharat din raat ||
lines.translation: and the four Vedas proclaim, day and night,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agam thaakur aagaadh ||
lines.translation: that the Lord and Master is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਭਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: gun bea(n)t bea(n)t bhan naanak kahan na jaaee parai paraat ||2||2||35||
lines.translation: Endless, endless are His Glories, says Nanak; they cannot be described - they are beyond our reach. ||2||2||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਏ ਗਾਏ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaae gaae karanaihaar ||
lines.translation: I meditate, and sing of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਓਹੀ ਰੇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau naahee sukh sahaj ana(n)daa anik ohee re ek samaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have become fearless, and I have found peace, poise and bliss, remembering the infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal moorat gur merai maathai ||
lines.translation: The Guru, of the most fruitful image, has placed His hand upon my forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat pekhau tat tat saathai ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there, I find Him with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal mere praan adhaar ||1||
lines.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Lord are the Support of my very breath of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹ ਬਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: samarath athaah badaa prabh meraa ||
lines.translation: My God is all-powerful, unfathomable and utterly vast.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar saahib neraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master is close at hand - He dwells in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਸਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: taakee saran aasar prabh naanak jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||2||3||36||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary and the Support of God, who has no end or limitation. ||2||3||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ulatee re man ulatee re ||
lines.translation: Turn away, O my mind, turn away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat siu kar ulatee re ||
lines.translation: Turn away from the faithless cynic.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਕੀ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothai kee re jhooth pareet chhutakee re man chhutakee re saakat sa(n)g na chhutakee re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: False is the love of the false one; break the ties, O my mind, and your ties shall be broken. Break your ties with the faithless cynic. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਜਰ ਭਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੂਖੀ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu kaajar bhar ma(n)dar raakhio jo paisai kaalookhee re ||
lines.translation: One who enters a house filled with soot is blackened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਓ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: doorahu hee te bhaag gaio hai jis gur mil chhutakee trikutee re ||1||
lines.translation: Run far away from such people! One who meets the Guru escapes from the bondage of the three dispositions. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜੁਟਸੀ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maagau daan kripaal kripaa nidh meraa mukh saakat sa(n)g na jutasee re ||
lines.translation: I beg this blessing of You, O Merciful Lord, ocean of mercy - please, don't bring me face to face with the faithless cyincs.
